definitions: To be actively involved in an activity or process at a particular moment.
To be experiencing or dealing with something, often something difficult or complex.
examples: I can't talk right now, I'm in the middle of cooking dinner.
She's in the middle of moving to a new city, so things are chaotic.
We're in the middle of a major project at work.
lemma: to be in the middle of something
synonyms: to be in the thick of it
to be in the midst of something
to be caught up in something
source: to be in the middle of something
